text:
pat: noticing an awkward UX with generator streams in the Go sample when we try to ForceClose during mid-stream auth swap.

pat: simple repro: start stream, spin goroutine to call stream.UpdateToken(token), cancel ctx, then immediately call stream.ForceClose(). Often ForceClose hangs waiting for UpdateToken to finish.

pat: snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
sh := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, req)
go func(){
  for t := range tokC { sh.UpdateToken(t) }
}()
// read one chunk
_ = sh.Recv()
// caller wants hard abort
cancel()
sh.ForceClose()
```

trin: hmm, ForceClose should preempt everything. sounds like UpdateToken acquires a mutex and ForceClose waits on same mutex. we need a lock ordering fix or make token update nonblocking.

cheng: alternative: make UpdateToken use atomic swap + notify send goroutine. ForceClose should close a transport context that cancels any blocking ops (use net.Conn.Close() + context cancellation). Avoid holding any SDK-level locks while doing network IO.

maya: ergonomics: expose Done() chan and Err() getter. Example idiom for callers:
```
sh := client.Gen.StreamV2(ctx, req)
select {
case <-ctx.Done():
  // cancel requested
  sh.ForceClose()
  <-sh.Done()
case <-sh.Done():
  // finished normally
}
if err := sh.Err(); err != nil { /* inspect cause */ }
```

pat: agree. also document that UpdateToken is nonblocking by default and add Reauth(ctx) if callers need synchronous reauth+error.

devrel-bot: note: open a draft PR with prefix "devex/forceclose-stream" to auto-assign devex + eng-runtime reviewers and request docs review if you change public API.

trin: small perf note: avoid per-chunk token copy; apply at next message boundary. tests should include a fake server that delays token handshake to ensure ForceClose aborts quickly.

pat: i'll prototype StreamV2 with Done/Err/ForceClose + SetTokenFast and add a minimal example in /examples/stream-abort. will ping runtime for kernel-level socket checks.

maya: thanks! this should clear a lot of ctrl-c hang tickets. :sparkles:
